Ball is Life.status_basis: Status: ESPN's injury report, updated for today's games from the NBA injury report (6:45am CT) and Sleeper. The official report wins when it's newer than ESPN's note; Sleeper fills gaps; sources that disagree with nothing official are shown as unconfirmed and nothing acts on them. A rest day (Out, injury management) counts for that game only.
